answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. This means an attacker must choose: either run a few high-quality identities, or many worthless ones — and neither option beats honest participation.. What makes it robust is that honest graders are financially motivated to reject the cluster, so fake votes lose their value before verdicts are tallied. Consider a grove as the anchor of the cost. A jetty stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a vault...
